 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It's been a wonderful 48 hours for United States Men's National Team captain Christian Pulisic.
 The day after extending his Milan contract to July of 2031, the 28-year-old has gone and delivered his best qualities against Inter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Saturday's Milan derby saw the deadlock broken less than five minutes in as the American was left unmarked in the box and leapt highest to find the far left corner.
 That's now 45 goals in 142 appearances for the Italian giants since joining the Rossoneri in July 2023.
 Not a bad way to celebrate the news for the LeBron James of soccer!
